'''Sargeron'''{{coords|74|28|Desolace}} was once a [[night elven]] [[city]], but has lain in [[ruin]]s since the [[War of the Ancients]]. The town's original name has been lost to time, but its ruins are now home to numerous [[satyr]] who have redubbed it Sargeron — after their demonic master [[Sargeras]].
